rows.title: Five verbs, nothing less
rows.defect: revoke is not required
rows.test: an adapter without revoke is refused

rows.title: Moving money is its own grant
rows.defect: the separate write consent is not required
rows.test: a write scope without its own consent throws

rows.title: The vault holds the token
rows.defect: the raw token is stored as the handle
rows.test: the record carries vh_conn_001, never the token

rows.title: Stamped with this sync's time
rows.defect: the stamp is the previous success time
rows.test: every datum is as of the sync

rows.title: Unknown is not $0.00
rows.defect: a null available amount reads as $0.00 (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: available: null stays null

rows.title: No basis is not a $0.00 basis
rows.defect: a null cost basis reads as $0.00 (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: cost_basis: null stays null

rows.title: A charge keeps its currency
rows.defect: transactions drop their currency (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: 45.00 EUR stays EUR

rows.title: The upload is what syncs
rows.defect: the CSV given at connect is dropped (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the CSV given at connect yields two rows

rows.title: Quoted cells are one cell
rows.defect: rows are split on every comma (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "STARBUCKS, SEATTLE WA" stays one description

rows.title: Revoke destroys the token
rows.defect: the vault entry is left in place
rows.test: the vault entry conn_001 is destroyed

rows.title: A sign-in error is a sign-in error
rows.defect: the aggregator's login code reads as broken
rows.test: ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED asks for a sign-in

rows.title: An outage is the HTTP status
rows.defect: any number from 500 to 599 in the message reads as an outage (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: "account 512 not found" is broken, not the provider down

rows.title: Said once, escalated once, then quiet
rows.defect: a third message goes out
rows.test: four failures make two messages

rows.title: Exactly twice the cadence is not stale
rows.defect: the boundary counts as stale
rows.test: two days after a banking sync is still healthy

rows.title: A yes before any move
rows.defect: the person's yes is not checked
rows.test: an unconfirmed $5.00 transfer never reaches the adapter

rows.title: No compliance gate, no move
rows.defect: a missing compliance gate lets the move through (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: without 53-compliance.js the transfer is refused

rows.title: The yes does not depend on the caller's gate
rows.defect: the gate's confirm flag decides (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a T1 label or a lax gate still needs a yes

rows.title: T5 by its own tier
rows.defect: only the gate's always flag marks a T5
rows.test: a T5 passed with a lax gate is still refused

rows.title: Only a healthy connection acts
rows.defect: the health check before the adapter is dropped
rows.test: a connection needing sign-in is refused

rows.title: Codes and numbers stay out of the log
rows.defect: only passwords, tokens, OTPs and SSNs are redacted (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: an MFA code, PIN and card number are redacted

rows.title: The ranking decides, not the latest reading
rows.defect: the newest reading wins
rows.test: the aggregator's balance beats a newer manual one

rows.title: Dollars and as-of, not raw cents
rows.defect: the conflict prints raw cents with no as-of (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: the conflict says $4,212.08 as of its sync time

rows.title: Due at exactly one cadence
rows.defect: the boundary waits another tick
rows.test: 15 minutes after a balance sync it is due

rows.title: A live session is the least reliable kind
rows.defect: a live session is labeled high
rows.test: describe() says low for a live session

rows.title: Only a good sync clears a sign-in
rows.defect: a health ping that answers OK clears NEEDS_REAUTH with no sync (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: an OK ping leaves NEEDS_REAUTH in place
